manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp193,426-427 and dictionary line170 describe DamageItem.REPF as repairable fraction 0..1, default0. Accepted endpoint runs show REPF1 repair/restock and REPF0 discard/stock loss in one seed.
source_delta: All eight inputs derive from byte-verified accepted REPF1 source; each changes only DamageItem.REPF 1 to 0.5, Control.RSEED from 1 to the named seed when needed, and ProblemDescription. DAMP1, PROB1, directly mounted LRU, one BASE-01 spare, explicit DamageReplacement, ordinary ItemRepair, three fixed missions and horizon36 remain fixed.
prior_diagnostic: A separate unaccepted seed1 REPF0.5 pair in H02-var03-repf-half-v1.0.0 produced a discard-only path matching REPF0. This eight-seed 1..8 set was frozen after that observation, before any of these eight runs; every preselected seed must be reported, including seed1. The prior result is disclosed and not used as independent evidence of frequency.

pre_run_hypotheses.realized_paths: Individual damaged LRUs may be repaired and returned or discarded after removal under REPF0.5. Outcomes are read from logs, not inferred from the input value or exit code.
pre_run_hypotheses.positive_acceptance: At least one logged damaged-LRU direct repair/stock return and at least one logged damaged-LRU discard across the eight preselected runs, with each path reconciled to stock demand/backorder, mission and report bins. If one path is absent, keep this package diagnostic and classify the limitation.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, no item damage, only one route across all seeds, unlogged stock recovery, or report inconsistency are diagnostic, not preaccepted. No exact split or frequency is expected.

acceptance_gates: Accepted direct parent and independent pre-run static review of all eight frozen sources, exact diff, contract, manual basis and guarded runner
Eight fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Each arm has exact 24/24 authored row-containing table roundtrip, zero converter errors, valid SXO/event log/report and 72 System/Stock bins
Both repair and discard paths observed with item identities; mission, physical stock and report ledgers reconciled for every preselected seed
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only replay of all eight arms
limits: Eight preselected seeds are a small deterministic set chosen after a disclosed seed1 diagnostic. They do not estimate a 50% population frequency, prove independence, or establish a statistical confidence interval.
Explicit DamageReplacement and ordinary ItemRepair are retained. This group does not test fallback priority, other item structures/stations, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
